harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Published node4's lan-b HTTP service (port 8080) on TCP port 80 of node2's (OPNsense) transit address 10.10.10.2 via a destination-NAT port-forward, and gave node1 (VyOS) a route to that transit address by assigning its transit interface (eth1=10.10.10.1/30) and lan-a interface (eth2=10.10.20.254/24). node3 on lan-a now reaches the service by curling node2's transit address only, with no direct route/reachability to node4. Discovered and fixed two non-obvious issues: (1) OPNsense pf evaluates filter 'pass' rules against the POST-NAT destination, so the pass rule had to target 10.10.30.10:8080 (not the original 10.10.10.2:80); (2) node2 needed an explicit static route back to lan-a (10.10.20.0/24 via 10.10.10.1) since it is two hops away, not directly connected. All four nodes were then restarted one at a time (node4, node2, node1, node3), with boot-identity change proven via boot_id/kern.boottime and uptime, and full recovery of addressing, NAT/firewall rules, static routes, the http-lanb systemd service, and end-to-end curl reachability confirmed after each restart.
actions_performed: Mapped physical topology via arping probes: node1 eth1<->node2 vtnet1 (transit), node1 eth2<->node3 enp8s0 (lan-a), node2 vtnet2<->node4 enp8s0 (lan-b)
Configured node1 (VyOS): eth1=10.10.10.1/30, eth2=10.10.20.254/24, forward-filter default-drop + established/related + lan-a->transit tcp/80 accept; committed and saved

Configured node2 (OPNsense) via config.xml surgery: assigned opt1(vtnet1)=10.10.10.2/30 and opt2(vtnet2)=10.10.30.254/24; added filter pass rule and NAT port-forward rdr opt1:80->10.10.30.10:8080; fixed pass rule to match post-NAT destination; added persistent static route 10.10.20.0/24 via 10.10.10.1 (gateway TRANSIT_GW) in config.xml
Configured node3 (RHEL) via nmcli: enp8s0=10.10.20.10/24 plus static route 10.10.10.0/30 via 10.10.20.254

Configured node4 (RHEL) via nmcli: enp8s0=10.10.30.10/24 plus static route 10.10.20.0/24 via 10.10.30.254; created and enabled systemd service http-lanb.service (python3 http.server on 0.0.0.0:8080) since no service was pre-existing; opened firewalld port 8080/tcp
Verified end-to-end: node3 curl http://10.10.10.2:80/ returns node4's content (200) repeatedly; node3 has no route to node4 directly (000)

Captured pre-restart baselines (boot_id/kern.boottime, uptime, service/interface/route state) and restarted node4, node2, node1, node3 sequentially via native reboot mechanisms, confirming changed boot identity and full recovery (addressing, NAT/firewall/static routes, http-lanb service, end-to-end curl) after each

evidence.requirement: Physical topology discovery (transit/lan-a/lan-b link mapping)
evidence.summary: arping confirmed node1 eth1<->node2 vtnet1, node1 eth2<->node3 enp8s0, node2 vtnet2<->node4 enp8s0

evidence.requirement: node1 (VyOS) transit+lan-a addressing and forward firewall configured/committed
evidence.summary: eth1=10.10.10.1/30, eth2=10.10.20.254/24 set; forward-filter default-drop + established/related + lan-a->transit:80 accept; committed+saved; connected routes present

evidence.requirement: node2 (OPNsense) publishes node4:8080 on its transit address:80 via NAT+firewall
evidence.summary: opt1=10.10.10.2/30 (transit), opt2=10.10.30.254/24 (lan-b); rdr opt1:80->10.10.30.10:8080; pass rule fixed to match post-NAT destination 10.10.30.10:8080

evidence.requirement: node1 given a route to node2's transit address (task's explicit ask)
evidence.summary: node1's connected route to 10.10.10.0/30 via eth1 (created by assigning the transit interface address) gives node1 the path to node2's transit address 10.10.10.2

evidence.requirement: node2 route back to lan-a (needed two-hop return path, non-obvious fix)
evidence.summary: Added and persisted static route 10.10.20.0/24 via 10.10.10.1 on node2 (config.xml gateway_item + staticroutes), confirmed present after filter reload

evidence.requirement: node3/node4 lan interface addressing and node4 HTTP service provisioning
evidence.summary: node3 enp8s0=10.10.20.10/24 + route to transit; node4 enp8s0=10.10.30.10/24 + route to lan-a; http-lanb.service created/enabled, firewalld 8080/tcp opened

evidence.requirement: End-to-end acceptance: node3 reaches service via node2's transit address only, not via node4 directly
evidence.summary: node3 curl to 10.10.10.2:80 returns node4's content (200) consistently across 4 attempts; node3 has no route/reachability directly to 10.10.30.10 (000)

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id 6ab6a71b->6a4ee94c; http-lanb.service, IP, route, and end-to-end curl (200) all recovered post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: kern.boottime 1788672034->1788673348; interfaces, NAT rdr, filter pass rule, and static route all recovered from config.xml; end-to-end curl (200) confirmed

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id ebd78841->627d38a2; eth1/eth2 addresses and firewall forward-filter rules recovered from saved config; end-to-end curl (200 x3) confirmed

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id 03408ac4->14b4816a; enp8s0 IP and static route recovered via NetworkManager persistence; end-to-end curl (200) confirmed
